name: A & L Sheet Metal Fabrications
old_description: Founded in 1993, A&L Sheet Metal specializes in sheet metal fabrication including shearing, punching, laser cutting, bending, drilling and tapping, welding & spotwelding, tool and die making and machining.
about:
Founded in 1993 in the Bronx, New York, A & L Sheet Metal Fabrications has operated as a sheet metal fabrication shop for over three decades. The company began as a local provider of custom metalwork and has since expanded its capabilities to serve a range of industrial clients.

The shop offers a full suite of sheet metal processes: shearing, punching, laser cutting, bending, drilling and tapping, welding and spot welding, tool and die making, and machining. These services are performed in-house, allowing the company to handle projects from prototype through production runs without outsourcing core operations.

A & L primarily serves the defense and aerospace sectors, supplying fabricated components that meet stringent quality requirements. Its customer base also includes other industrial manufacturers requiring precision sheet metal parts for assemblies and enclosures.

The company emphasizes a distinguished level of service and the integration of cutting‑edge technology as its key differentiators. It maintains an ISO 9001:2008 certified quality management system, which it cites as essential to meeting customer timetables and delivering consistent results.
